extraction_notes: All p-channel voltage and current magnitudes in numeric fields are stored as positive magnitudes; signs are preserved in condition text where shown.
Transfer, output, and capacitance curves were digitized from Figures 1, 2, and 7 on pages 3-4; points are direct figure reads and were not interpolated.
The strict schema has one resistance value per RDS(on) point, so the published typical and maximum values for each VGS/ID pair are retained as separate entries.

The supplied datasheet also publishes gate charge, switching times, body-diode reverse recovery, thermal resistance, leakage, safe operating area, and thermal curves, but the strict extraction schema has no fields for those items.
No datasheet revision identifier is stated in the supplied PDF.
